scenes.title: St Ann has Jamaica's most Airbnbs: 703 listings
scenes.vo: St Ann tops Jamaica with seven hundred and three live Airbnb listings, more than any other parish.
About one in six of the four thousand one hundred and fifteen Airbnbs in our data.
Kingston and St Andrew is second, with five hundred and forty-seven. St James is third, with four hundred and seventy-seven.

scenes.desc: Median nightly rate in St Ann, all sizes (about $121 US)
scenes.vo: The typical St Ann Airbnb charges about ninety pounds a night, or a hundred and twenty-one US dollars.
More listings means more competition. Check nearby rates and occupancy before you buy.
